omitted_fixed_vocabulary_class_semantics: confidence exactly 0 by prospective sparse serialization definition; never an imputation for a missing response
binary_constant_or_tied_numeric_vectors: retain as supplied; diagnostic only; no score-variation filtering
truncated_missing_transport_error_or_mal: invalid; no repaired, filled or selected replacement vector
full_primary_metric_gate: all planned cases must have valid complete sparse-vector representations; otherwise full-set auprc@micro and f1_max are null
parsed_only_diagnostics: if reported, use PARSED_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC namespace with exact valid/planned counts; never full-set scores
native_functions: TorchDrug metrics.area_under_prc on flattened confidence/target matrices
tie_rule: pinned source argsort rank positions, including within tied scores; future scorer must freeze Torch CPU/runtime ordering before outputs; do not silently replace with sklearn tie-grouped AP or threshold-grid Fmax
output_score_propagation: none, matching audited ProtST/TorchDrug task evaluator; scorer targets already include source annotation closure
confidence_evidence: numeric values explicitly generated by the model in final JSON, not labels converted to one/zero
